description.value: Sal y Limon is a family-founded Mexican restaurant inspired by traditional recipes from Manzanillo, Mexico, serving tacos, tortas, burritos, and other street food-style dishes. The South Surrey location is part of a small Vancouver-area chain created by four food enthusiasts who wanted to bring authentic Mexican flavour to BC. The restaurant emphasizes a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and offers both pick-up and delivery ordering.
